title: Part 4 廣告
summary: 聽廣告：賣什麼、有什麼優惠、怎麼參加。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 廣告是 Part 4 常見的類型。開頭常用問句吸引人：Are you looking for…?（你在找…嗎？）
廣告必考三件事：賣什麼（What is being advertised?）、有什麼優惠（discount、free）、要怎麼做（visit、call、sign up）。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 類型
開頭常聽到
常考
rows: Are you looking for…? Want to…?
折扣多少、怎樣才能拿到
Visit our website. Sign up before…

steps.tip: 30% off 在選項常寫成 a discount（折扣）；get your first month free 常寫成 a free month。

items.en: Everything in the store is thirty percent off.
We will deliver your furniture for free.
items.zh: 我們會免費幫你運送家具。
請在五月二十日前報名。

items.en: Visit our website to see the full schedule.
items.zh: 請上我們的網站看完整課表。

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再按 ▶ 聽。每段有 3 題。

questions.explanation:
Home Style Furniture：家具店。
逐字稿：Are you looking for a new sofa? Come to Home Style Furniture this weekend! Everything in the store is 30% off. We are open from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday. And if you spend more than $500, we will deliver your furniture for free.

30% off 就是打折（a discount）。
逐字稿：Are you looking for a new sofa? Come to Home Style Furniture this weekend! Everything in the store is 30% off. We are open from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday. And if you spend more than $500, we will deliver your furniture for free.

questions.explanation:
English, Japanese, and Spanish：語言課。
逐字稿：Want to learn a new language? City Language School offers small classes in English, Japanese, and Spanish. Classes start on June 1. Sign up before May 20 and get your first month free. Visit our website to see the full schedule.

Classes start on June 1. May 20 是報名優惠的截止日。
